title: Noise-Guided Predicate Representation Extraction and Diffusion-Enhanced Discretization for Scene Graph Generation
reviewed_version: PMLR 267 published version fetched from supplied mlresearch source URL
summary: Two Major findings: distance-supervision direction and unresolved release definitions; two Minor findings: printed KL and head-preservation overstatement. Independent acceptance corrected the initial miscopied Open Images comparison.
limitations: Current source snapshot is not historical experiment provenance.
No author program imported or executed; no datasets/checkpoints/raw predictions reproduced.
Core modules read fully; other backbones, detector internals and complete evaluator not audited.
Source plots actually viewed qualitatively, not digitized.

problems.claim: Distance-to-onehot supervision favors a wrong nearest prototype.
problems.evidence: Feature0, true prototype1, wrong prototype0 gives zero supervised and commitment losses with wrong selection. Intended training chain statically traced.
problems.alternative_explanation: Other losses and learned decoder may compensate; no claim every prediction must fail.
problems.repair: Use label-consistent distance/similarity objective; verify indices and rerun affected ablations with identified historical version.

independent_verification.source_claim: Eq15 physical p5 selects argmin distance. Eq20 physical p6 regresses this distance to true-class one-hot. Actual p6 pixels confirm the distance and true-class labels, not a decreasing similarity.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: The paper says normalized but supplies no decreasing transform; diffusion_utils.py359-396 explicitly computes squared Euclidean distances, argmin and MSE against one_hot. FDM.forward398-435 passes labels and returns quantizer losses, propagated through model_utils550-558.
independent_verification.counterevidence: Other reconstruction/decision-head losses can compensate, and release errors prevent claiming a measured training run. This is a counterexample to the asserted supervision mechanism, not universal classifier failure.
independent_verification.core_dependency: The loss intended to prevent incorrect codebook associations is a central proposed mechanism and directly rewards a wrong nearest class in an attainable configuration.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Major retained on mechanism dependence, irrespective of how short the repair may be. A negative-distance cross entropy or explicitly decreasing similarity can repair the direction; actual historical configuration and ablations must be identified and checked.

problems.claim: Supplied two-stage training path lacks VAE_decoder attribute and FDM binding.
problems.evidence: Full source reading, AST global bindings and repository-wide text search.
problems.alternative_explanation: An omitted patch/file or different historical version may explain the release.
problems.dependency: Public reconstruction of both core training stages, not proof historical experiments failed.
problems.repair: Publish complete runnable version and versioned configs/checkpoint correspondence.

independent_verification.source_claim: Read train.sh first/second stage, NoDIS constructor28-176 and forward443-509, model_utils.py269-273, and global imports. Advertised flags enable the stage1 decoder call; stage2 constructor invokes build_diff_modules.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: NoDIS extends nn.Module; all acquired Python files were searched without import or execution. AST top-level binding analysis finds no FDM; the only VAE_decoder occurrence is the call at485. train.sh sets global representation and denoise true, while constructor enables node branch.
independent_verification.counterevidence: Missing files/patches or historical programs can explain a broken public snapshot. Static checks establish unresolved names under advertised flags, not original experimental nonexecution or the earliest runtime error.
independent_verification.core_dependency: Both central advertised training stages cannot be reconstructed from the supplied snapshot after ordinary external paths/dependencies are supplied.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Major release-reconstruction obstacle retained; publish a complete version and associate configs/checkpoints with tables. Do not infer the historical scores are false.

problems.claim: Printed Gaussian KL replaces logvariance difference by variance difference.
problems.evidence: Equal means,variances3and2 gives-.25 versus correct.0472674; current code correct.
problems.dependency: Mathematical specification; no demonstrated training error.
problems.repair: Correct formula and confirm historical implementation.

independent_verification.source_claim: Actually inspected Eq18 p6 pixels: the final terms inside the negative half bracket are exp(logvc)-exp(logvp). Read model_utils.py435-441 correct logvariance difference.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: Scalar same-mean Gaussians with positive variances3,2 satisfy the stated family.
independent_verification.counterevidence: The supplied implementation uses the correct logvariance expression; a printed typo is supported and an implementation-wide KL error is not.
independent_verification.core_dependency: Mathematical specification of an auxiliary loss; actual training damage not established.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor retained; replace exponentiated terms by log variances and verify historical correspondence.

problems.claim: Unconditional head-preservation wording exceeds the displayed head/body/tail tradeoff; original Open Images numerical counterexample withdrawn.
problems.evidence: Actual Table2 BGNN OIV4 wmAPrel is37.8, below NoDIS38.21. OIV6 38.95 versus one-decimal39.0 is not a robust strict-order claim. Table6 VTransE head30.05<34.5 supports a4.45-point head decline.
problems.alternative_explanation: Open Images nominal phrase difference can be rounding; overall weighted performance and body/tail improvements remain favorable.
problems.dependency: Strength of comparative narrative, not complete ranking reversal.
problems.repair: Qualify head preservation and report the tradeoff with matched configurations; withdraw the false OIV4 counterexample.

independent_verification.source_claim: Actually inspected Table2 p9 pixels and read p8 statement and Table6/AppendixB p14. The initial report miscopied BGNN OIV4 wmAPrel: it is37.8, not38.8.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: NoDIS38.21 is above37.8. OIV6 BCTR39.0 is shown at one decimal while NoDIS38.95 has two; the nominal .05 difference does not establish a substantive deficit and can be compatible with rounding. Table6 VTransE head34.5 versus NoDIS30.05 is a clear displayed decline.

decisive_check.OIV6_comparison: insufficient printed precision for strict ordering

independent_verification.counterevidence: Withdraw the false OIV4 counterexample and the claim that an OIV6 tie requires uncertainty analysis. Weighted Open Images results remain favorable; body/tail improve. Historical matched baseline configuration is not established.
independent_verification.core_dependency: Only the unconditional head-preservation narrative is contradicted by a robust displayed comparison; no global score reversal or definite Open Images failure is established.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for head-performance wording, with false/overstrong subclaims removed. State the head/body/tail tradeoff and avoid precision-based claims of strict superiority.

repair_verification: Own numeric checks and static source checks complete; historical correspondence and empirical effect require author records.
